findings: NF4 reduces memory consumption relative to FP16 with a small quantization error.
limitations: Only weight memory is compared; activation memory is not studied.
objectives: Compare NF4 and FP16 weight representations on memory and model quality.
brief.problem: Large language model weights consume too much memory for single-device inference.
